_context.switch.label: Name of the setting that picks how the workspace is drawn: as the 3D board, or as the Simple view (a list of coworkers beside the chat).
_context.switch.board: The isometric 3D board of the workspace. Keep it short, it labels an icon.
_context.switch.simple: The Simple view of the workspace: a list of coworkers on the left, the chat in the middle. Keep it short, it labels an icon.
_context.list.label: Accessible name of the list of the workspace's coworkers.
_context.tile.more: Accessible name of the '…' button on a coworker's row. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.chat.pick: Shown in the middle of the Simple view when no coworker is open.
_context.line.workingOn: Status line under a coworker's name: it is running, {detail} is the title of its conversation or its description.
_context.line.asleepAbout: Status line under a coworker's name: its machine is off, {about} is its description.
_context.line.waiting: Line under a coworker's name in the list, when it waits on the person and its conversation has no title.
_context.foreman.line: Line under the Chief of Staff's name at the top of the list of coworkers: it invites the person to ask it anything.
_context.line.you: Line under a coworker's name: the last message of its latest conversation, written by the person reading. {message} is that message, cut to one line.
_context.details.close: Accessible name of the veil behind the coworker's card when it lies over the chat on a narrow window: clicking it closes the card.
_context.details.label: Accessible name of the column showing a coworker's card. {name} is the coworker's name.
_context.phone.section: Accessible name of a collapsible Box header in the phone's list: the Box's name and how many coworkers it holds.
_context.phone.byBox: Option of the phone's list: the coworkers grouped by Box (a group of coworkers) rather than by recency.

chat.pick: Pick a coworker on the left.
